description: We offer workshops on any of Shakespeare's plays or any classical play your class is studying.
title: In Schools
Tours
description: Bring a touring Shakespeare performance or workshop to your school, library, or community venue across Fairfield County.

Two teaching artists bring Shakespeare's language to life using games and theatre exercises. Students explore content, language, and relationships — and discover how themes connect to their everyday life. Grades K–12, $700 for up to 4 workshops.
title: Trippingly on the Tongue

description: Two actors perform excerpts from the play, then teaching artists guide students through language and meaning. Grades 7–12, $1,200 for up to 4 workshops in one day.
title: All the World's a Stage

description: A 45-minute AP English enrichment presentation followed by a 15-minute Q&A. Examines the Q1, Q2 and F versions of Hamlet. Unlimited attendees, Grades 9–12, $400.
title: Page to Stage: Hamlet

description: For educators of all grades — our teaching artists instruct teachers on educational theater pedagogy using Forum Theater, Image Theater, and Teacher-in-Role techniques.
title: Teacher's Workshop

description: Visit our education tent in Pinkney Park, Rowayton before the show. Watch Shakespeare in 30 Minutes — a half-hour version of our MainStage production — 30 minutes before showtime.
title: In the Park

description: Summer camps for children ages 8–15. The Globe Company presents Scenes from Shakespeare — designed for the budding actor. No Shakespeare or acting experience necessary.
title: Summer Camps

description: Apprenticeships run mid-May through early July. Apprentices perform the Pre-Show, attend master classes in NYC, and create their own shows through Budding Bards. Internships available in various disciplines.
title: Professional Training
